h1.en: Diesel 30 Prints Two Aggregate Wordings is a catalogue comparison, not a page from Coal combustion products
h1.zh: 柴油30为什么出现两种骨料说法是目录对照，不是「Coal combustion products」那一页

directAnswer.en: Read both published wordings on the Diesel 30 concrete pump from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. The specification table lists maximum aggregate size as 3 cm and below. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Coal_combustion_products.
directAnswer.zh: 柴油30混凝土泵来自河北品锦机械在邢台的页面，两种已公布说法都要读。规格表的最大骨料粒径是 3 cm 及以下。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Coal_combustion_products。

body.en: Picture source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Coal_combustion_products. Subject: Coal combustion products. Read both published wordings on the Diesel 30 concrete pump from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. This note does not choose a winner. It does not contain a second aggregate row labelled 1 cm. It has not published a sentence that says the parenthesis replaces the table, or the reverse. Until the factory confirms, quote the conflict instead of hiding one of the lines.
body.zh: 图片来源：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Coal_combustion_products。画面主体：Coal combustion products。柴油30混凝土泵来自河北品锦机械在邢台的页面，两种已公布说法都要读。配合比请通过 /zh/contact/ 确认。它没有公布一句说括号代替表格，或表格代替括号。

body.en: The specification table lists maximum aggregate size as 3 cm and below. Confirm the mix through /en/contact/. The short introduction on Diesel 30, Diesel 40 and Diesel 50 includes the parenthesis 1 cm aggregate. Do not average 1 cm and 3 cm.
body.zh: 规格表的最大骨料粒径是 3 cm 及以下。柴油30的表包含最大骨料粒径 3 cm 及以下，以及发动机 4105 / 56 kW、15 m³/h、20 MPa、距离 60 m / 180 m。不要把电动20的 1–2 cm 抄进柴油30来打破僵局。

body.en: The introductory line lists 60 m / 180 m and, in parentheses, 1 cm aggregate. Diesel 30's table includes maximum aggregate size 3 cm and below, with engine 4105 / 56 kW, 15 m³/h, 20 MPa and distance 60 m / 180 m. On Diesel 40 and Diesel 50 there is no aggregate line in the specification table to compare. Do not copy Electric 20's 1–2 cm into Diesel 30 to break the tie.
body.zh: 介绍句标出了 60 m / 180 m，括号里又写 1 cm 骨料。柴油30、柴油40和柴油50的简短介绍都带括号“1 cm aggregate”。工厂确认之前，应写出这个不一致，而不是藏起其中一行。

body.en: Diesel 40 and Diesel 50 introductions also say 1 cm aggregate, while their specification tables list no aggregate row at all. That table is the structured entry list. Hebei Pinjin Machinery has published both texts. Send the model and the mix to the contact page.
body.zh: 柴油40和柴油50的介绍也写了 1 cm 骨料，但它们的规格表根本没有骨料行。柴油40和柴油50的规格表里没有骨料行可以对照。

question.en: On this row: What does the Diesel 30 table say?

answer.en: Maximum aggregate size is 3 cm and below. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Coal_combustion_products.
answer.zh: 最大骨料粒径为 3 cm 及以下。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Coal_combustion_products画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Where does 1 cm appear?

answer.en: In the introductory line of Diesel 30, and also in the introductions of Diesel 40 and Diesel 50. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Coal_combustion_products.
answer.zh: 在柴油30的介绍句里，柴油40和柴油50的介绍句里也有。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Coal_combustion_products画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Do Diesel 40 and Diesel 50 have a table row for aggregate?
question.zh: 柴油40和柴油50的表格有骨料行吗？

answer.en: No. Their specification tables omit that row. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Coal_combustion_products.
answer.zh: 没有。它们的规格表省略了这一行。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Coal_combustion_products画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Should the website pick 1 cm or 3 cm?
question.zh: 网站应该选定 1 cm 还是 3 cm？

answer.en: No. Hebei Pinjin Machinery has not shown a rule that discards either wording. Ask the factory. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Coal_combustion_products.
answer.zh: 不应该。河北品锦机械没有写出一条规则来废弃其中一种说法。请问工厂。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Coal_combustion_products画面里印出的数字。
